About This Site # This is a platform where a student of theoretical physics records and shares what he learns and researches.
About Me # I am Peter Benjamin Zhu, an undergraduate student, known online in Chinese as 学物理的咸鱼.
Struggling to stay afloat in the ocean of physics
Interests # My interests in theoretical physics include:
Classical gravity Quantum gravity Black holes The anti-de Sitter/conformal field theory correspondence (AdS/CFT correspondence) Cosmology Interest categories: hep-th (High Energy Physics - Theory) and gr-qc (General Relativity and Quantum Cosmology).
Skills and Tools # Proficient in using Python and Mathematica for numerical and analytical research. Proficient in writing articles with Markdown and LaTeX. Contact Me # Email: 19973397352@163.com Gmail: peterbenjamin9978@gmail.com Zhihu: My profile I welcome discussions about physics, theoretical physics, general relativity, quantum gravity, mathematics, high-energy physics, and learning.
